results.title: Noirelle
results.body_html:
Cash on Delivery Payment method is not available for International Customers.


Crafted on a velvet base, Noirelle features a deep jet-black hue highlighted with intricate antique gold and silver embroidery. Delicate scattered motifs add subtle texture, while the richly detailed border showcases refined geometric and floral patterns. The contrast between the velvet and metallic threadwork creates a striking yet elegant statement, making Noirelle an ideal choice for the festive season and formal celebrations.

 

Color:   Jet Black

The short classic kurta features a straight front and back with round hems, straight sleeves with slit, and a Magzi V-neckline, accented with delicate lace. Paired with a dyed lawn shalwar and a digital printed lawn dupatta, this ensemble blends style with all-day comfort.
